newsitem.title: THAILAND: Sahaviriya expects to complete port study in July.
newsitem.headline: Sahaviriya expects to complete port study in July.

text.p: Thailand's Sahaviriya Group said on Monday it expected to complete its feasibility study on a deep sea port in Burma by July.

Adisak Lowjun, president of Sahaviriya Steel Industries Plc, told Sahaviriya at a press conference the feasibility study has been conducted jointly by Nippon Koei Co Ltd and Thailand's SEATEC Co Ltd since March.
Sahaviriya Steel is a Sahaviriya Group unit.
According to the plan, a 120-km (74.5-mile) landbridge would be built to link the Thai southern Prachuab Khiri Khan province with the Burmese town of Popin.
Adisak said the deep seaport would help cut shipping costs for goods moved through Thailand.
Sahaviriya Steel produces hot-rolled coil and steel. -- Bangkok newsroom (662) 652-0642
